text.p: Titan Pharmaceuticals Inc on Thursday said agreed to sell its GSX System to Pharmaceutical Product Development Inc for about $8.7 million.
The sale of the GSX System, a technology used in drug research, was made through Ingenex Inc, Titan's majority-owned subsidiary, the company said.
As part of the transaction, Mark Furth, chief executive of Ingenex, will join Pharmaceutical Product Development, though he will remain on the Ingenex Board of Directors.

"Titan has chosen to concentrate its resources on the rapid development of later-stage, proprietary therapeutic products against cancer and central nervous system diseases," Louis Bucalo, Titan's chief executive, said in a statement.
He said funds from the sale will be used to develop several other drugs used in human testing that with "expedited clinical development will potentially provide major value drivers for (Titan)."
